verdict.rationale: Treasury Prime is API-first, and its docs show broad programmatic coverage: account opening and KYC, ACH/wire/FedNow/book transfers and returns, full card lifecycle management, disputes, account locking and closing, statements, 1099-INT filing, and full webhook CRUD. However, nothing documents parity with a UI, and API key creation and management are described only through the Developer Sandbox account interface, which suggests at least some UI-only functions. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, API-based key and credential management, documentation of which dashboard functions (if any) lack API equivalents, and independent corroboration.
